mapper.sql: SELECT d.document_id AS id,d.document_code AS code,d.document_title AS title,d.document_category AS category,o.employee_code AS owner,d.document_scope AS scope,dep.department_code AS department,d.document_status AS status,d.current_version_id AS currentVersionId,assignee.employee_code AS reviewer FROM document d JOIN employee o ON o.employee_id=d.owner_employee_id LEFT JOIN department dep ON dep.department_id=d.department_id LEFT JOIN employee assignee ON assignee.employee_id=d.review_assignee_id
mapper.select: WHERE d.document_code=#{code} FOR UPDATE OF d.document_status

SELECT v.version_id AS id,v.version_no AS number,v.content_format AS format,v.body_text AS body,v.version_state AS state,f.ai_searchable AS aiSearchable,f.external_ai_allowed AS externalAllowed,f.synthetic_yn AS synthetic,f.non_sensitive_yn AS nonSensitive FROM document_version v JOIN document_fragment f ON f.version_id=v.version_id AND f.fragment_no=1 WHERE v.document_id=#{id} ORDER BY v.version_no
SELECT e.employee_code AS employeeCode,g.permission_code AS permission FROM document_grant g JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id=g.employee_id WHERE g.document_id=#{id} AND g.revoked_at IS NULL
SELECT tag_value FROM document_tag WHERE document_id=#{id} ORDER BY tag_value
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document (document_code,document_title,document_category,owner_employee_id,department_id,document_scope,document_status) SELECT #{code},#{title},#{category},o.employee_id,dep.department_id,#{scope},'DRAFT' FROM employee o LEFT JOIN department dep ON dep.department_code=#{department} WHERE o.employee_code=#{owner}

INSERT INTO document_version (document_id,version_no,content_format,body_text,version_state,created_by_employee_id) SELECT #{id},#{number},#{format},#{body,jdbcType=CLOB},'DRAFT',owner_employee_id FROM document WHERE document_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT version_id FROM document_version WHERE document_id=#{id} AND version_no=#{number}
mapper.update: UPDATE document_version SET content_format=#{format},body_text=#{body,jdbcType=CLOB} WHERE version_id=#{id} AND version_state='DRAFT'
UPDATE document_fragment SET body_text=#{body,jdbcType=CLOB},ai_searchable=#{ai} WHERE version_id=#{id} AND fragment_no=1
UPDATE document_version SET version_state=#{to},published_at=CASE WHEN #{to}='PUBLISHED' THEN SYSTIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END WHERE version_id=#{id} AND version_state=#{from}
UPDATE document SET document_status=#{status},review_assignee_id=(SELECT employee_id FROM employee WHERE employee_code=#{reviewer}),updated_at=SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE document_id=#{id}
UPDATE document SET document_status=#{status},current_version_id=CASE WHEN #{current}=0 THEN NULL ELSE #{current} END,review_assignee_id=NULL,updated_at=SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE document_id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_review (document_id,version_id,reviewer_employee_id,decision_code) SELECT #{id},#{version},employee_id,#{decision} FROM employee WHERE employee_code=#{reviewer}

MERGE INTO document_grant g USING (SELECT #{id} AS doc_id,e.employee_id AS emp_id,#{permission} AS perm,a.employee_id AS actor_id FROM employee e CROSS JOIN employee a WHERE e.employee_code=#{employee} AND a.employee_code=#{actor}) src ON (g.document_id=src.doc_id AND g.employee_id=src.emp_id AND g.permission_code=src.perm) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET revoked_at=NULL,revoked_by_employee_id=NULL,granted_by_employee_id=src.actor_id,granted_at=SYSTIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (document_id,employee_id,permission_code,granted_by_employee_id) VALUES (src.doc_id,src.emp_id,src.perm,src.actor_id)
mapper.update: UPDATE document_grant SET revoked_at=SYSTIMESTAMP,revoked_by_employee_id=(SELECT employee_id FROM employee WHERE employee_code=#{actor}) WHERE document_id=#{id} AND employee_id=(SELECT employee_id FROM employee WHERE employee_code=#{employee}) AND permission_code=#{permission} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_event (actor_employee_id,event_code,resource_type,resource_id,outcome_code) SELECT employee_id,#{event},'DOCUMENT',#{code},'SUCCESS' FROM employee WHERE employee_code=#{actor}
